lines.text: An angel sends Philip south to the desert road from Jerusalem to Gaza, where he meets an Ethiopian eunuch.
The treasury official had gone to Jerusalem to worship and was reading Isaiah in his chariot.
The Spirit tells Philip to go to the chariot, and Philip runs up and asks where the man got his scroll.

wrong_details.wrong: asks where the man got his scroll
wrong_details.true: asks whether the man understands what he is reading
